attchmntText: Behari Lal Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Behari Lal Engineering Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 17 November 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of INR154.2 crores for the quarter, up 21.7% year-on-year. Profit after tax rose 27.7% to INR17.4 crores. EBITDA margin improved to 17.9%. For the half-year, revenue was INR305.8 crores and profit after tax was INR36.6 crores. The company remains debt-free with INR114.6 crores in cash. High-value products accounted for 62.9% of revenue. The third unit is under construction and expected to commission next year. The order book stands at INR179.4 crores. INR30.4 crores of the INR93 crore fresh issue proceeds have been utilized.

attchmntText: Behari Lal Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Behari Lal Engineering Limited, scrip code 544870, symbol BLEL, has filed an audio recording of its Investors and Analysts Conference Call. The call was held on 17 November 2026 at 4:30 p.m. IST. It discussed financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. This filing follows the intimation dated 4 November 2026. The audio recording is available on the company website at https://www.beharilalengineering.com/Quarter-Results-November.php. The submission complies with Regulation 46(2)(oa) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Sanjeev Kumar Sehgal, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, membership number A68134, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Behari Lal Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Behari Lal Engineering Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 154.2 crore rupees for Q2 FY27, representing a 21.7% year-on-year increase. Profit after tax stood at 27.6 crore rupees, up 27.7% year-on-year. EBITDA margin was 17.4%, and PAT margin was 11.3%. The order book grew to 179.4 crore rupees. The company entered the second half debt-free with a debt to equity ratio of 0.0. Installed capacity is 1,19,690 metric tons per annum. The presentation was uploaded to the company website.

attchmntText: Behari Lal Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Behari Lal Engineering Limited announced the publication of its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 14 November 2026. Advertisements were published on 16 November 2026 in Business Standard and Aj Di Awaaz. Separately, Pegasus Assets Reconstruction Private Limited issued a public notice for the e-auction sale of immovable secured assets under the SARFAESI Act. The borrower is M/s. Jaldhara Exports, with guarantors including Mr. Raman Kumar Garg and Mrs. Seema Gupta. The reserve price is Rs. 3,28,37,000. The e-auction is scheduled for 08 December 2026. The outstanding dues are Rs. 12,24,41,051.58 as on 21 September 2026.

desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Behari Lal Engineering Limited submitted unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Ashwani & Associates issued a review report stating nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. Total assets stood at 4,743.73 million rupees as at 30th September 2026 compared to 3,678.73 million rupees as at 31st March 2026. Total equity was 4,272.56 million rupees. Profit before tax for the half year was 491.56 million rupees compared to 390.13 million rupees in the corresponding period of 2025. Revenue from operations was 3,058.24 million rupees. Net cash flow from operating activities was 168.56 million rupees. Net cash flow from investing activities was negative 668.15 million rupees. Net cash flow from financing activities was 661.69 million rupees. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period were 173.52 million rupees. The figures for the corresponding period in 2025 were approved by the Board but not audited.
